stem.text: Which statement about gas exchange between air in the alveoli and blood in the pulmonary capillaries is correct?

A.text: The oxygen concentration in the capillaries leaving the pulmonary artery is higher than the oxygen concentration in the alveoli.

B.text: Gases must diffuse across the endothelium of the pulmonary capillaries and the endothelium of the alveoli.

C.text: The elastic fibres in the alveoli walls allow the alveoli to expand to increase the surface area available for diffusion into the pulmonary capillaries.

D.text: Breathing out reduces the carbon dioxide concentration gradient between the blood in the pulmonary capillaries and the air in the alveoli.
